title: Shove Ha'penny
tagline: Slide it. Nudge it. Fill all nine beds.
description: The English pub game of coins on slate with real sliding physics. Shove coins into nine narrow beds, win three chalks a bed, and beat four rivals or a friend.
howToPlay: Drag along the near edge to place the coin.
Drag up the board to aim: the ghost coin shows where it will stop. Let go to shove.
A coin wholly inside a bed is a chalk; on a line it is dead.
Three chalks fill a bed; extra coins in your full bed help your rival.
Nudge coins on with the next one; first to fill nine beds wins.
